list.name: Binance
list.inrDeposit: Via P2P and partners; terms vary
list.inrWithdrawal: Via P2P and partners; terms vary
notes: FIU-registered global exchange; the regular-user spot fee is 0.10% per order, with 25% off when fees are paid in BNB.
INR moves in and out mainly through P2P and payment partners rather than direct bank rails, which adds its own friction and spread.

list.name: Bitbns
list.inrDeposit: Paused at the time of checking
notes: The 0.25% standard fee drops to 0.1875% only if you hold BNS tokens and enable Pay with BNS.
INR deposits were paused for maintenance when we checked; confirm they are live before opening an account.

list.name: ZebPay
notes: 0.45% applies on the exchange order book below ₹5 lakh of 30-day volume; the simpler Quick Trade screen charges 0.5% or more.
INR deposits are free and withdrawals cost a flat ₹15.

list.name: CoinDCX
notes: 0.50% applies on INR spot below ₹2 lakh of 30-day volume; it falls to 0.42% up to ₹5 lakh and 0.17% beyond that.
Some newly listed pairs carry an extra "coverage fee" on top of the base rate.

list.name: CoinSwitch
list.feeLabel: Not published; shown at order time
notes: CoinSwitch does not publish a public fee schedule; the fee for each order is shown on the preview screen before you confirm, and part of the cost sits in the buy–sell spread.
A cost you can only see per order is hard to compare; check the preview against the exchanges above before trading.

list.name: Mudrex
list.feeLabel: Not published; shown at order time
notes: Mudrex does not publish a public spot fee schedule; the fee appears on the order screen before you confirm.
A cost you can only see per order is hard to compare; check the preview against the exchanges above before trading.
